request.subject: UNIT:FIGHTER

layers.text: Redraw him as a simple levy swordsman, the lightest soldier of the army: a small plain round wooden shield of light brown planks with a steel boss instead of the big heraldic shield; a padded cream linen jacket under a short crimson tabard with a small gold cross, brown belt and boots; no chainmail and no plate; a simple open steel cap with a small crimson crest. Keep the face, the sword held up, pose, proportions, thick black outline and art style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
